data.ruling: The refutation does not hold. The stock verifier failed exactly one check, "second-vendor stock". That check failed because nothing was read, not because a reading fell below the gate. The verifier itself says "This is not a reading below the gate of 50". Rule 5's second-vendor route asks for stock at or above the gate in Digi-Key's API. The gate is 50: need 5 = 5 boards (S7) x 1 placement, and S4 gives max(5 x 5, 50). No reading shows the part below that gate. The only API reading in the evidence is P2's response of 2026-09-28T17:19:23Z: HTTP 200, stock_available 55692, status Active, lead 11 weeks. That is 55692 >= 50. The earlier T2 P3 reading of 13:32:06Z gives the same 55692. My own re-read of productdetails also answered HTTP 429 'Daily Ratelimit exceeded' (18:33:31Z, x-ratelimit-remaining 0), so no fresh figure contradicts the 17:19:23Z reading. On the rest of the evidence the part stands. JLCPCB C511465 is an exact match: stockCount 2924 and canPresaleNumber 2913, against a gate of 50, which passes rule 4. LCSC productCycle is 'normal'. Vishay's PCN (product change notice) listing names no VBUS54CV part. The datasheet verifier confirmed every requirement value. The maker's status is not read, because the product page body carries none. That goes to the owner under the Lifecycle check, and it was never a refutation. Current limitation: Digi-Key stock, lead time and ProductStatus were not re-verified after 17:19:23Z. Re-read them with vendors.py digikey VBUS54CV-HSF-G4-08 after the rate limit resets at 2026-09-29T00:00:00Z. If they had failed, the failure would be a stock-gate matter for this function's need, so the scope is function.

The body said 'Daily Ratelimit exceeded' (correlationId ee157ab0-e985-414a-ffc2-3123b9a97c8b) and ratelimit_remaining was 0. Not read, for that reason. Stock is 54000 on tape and reel (VBUS54CV-HSF-G4-08TR-ND, minimum 3000), 55692 on cut tape (CT-ND, minimum 1) and 55692 on Digi-Reel, with stock_available 55692. Gate: need 5 = 5 boards (S7, Research.md:516) x 1 placement. S4 (Research.md:513) gives max(25, 50) = 50, and 55692 >= 50. The stock verifier's own readings pass: JLCPCB C511465 exact match, stockCount 2924, canPresaleNumber 2913 (18:22:55Z); LCSC productCycle 'normal' (18:26:34Z); no VBUS54CV in Vishay's 2532 PCN entries (18:25:41Z).
